title: Flat Feet, In-Toeing and Bow Legs in Children — When to Reassure and When to Refer

hook.en: Parents worry when a child's feet turn in or have no arch. Most of these are normal stages of growth. Learn how to examine, reassure with confidence and spot the few that need a specialist.
hook.ur: Walidain pareshan hote hain jab bachay ke pair andar ki taraf murte hain ya arch nahi hota. Zyada tar yeh nashonuma ke normal marahil hain. Examine karna, itminan se tasalli dena aur woh chand pehchanna seekhein jin ke liye specialist chahiye.

goal.en: By the end, you'll tell a flexible flat foot, in-toeing and physiological bow legs from conditions that need referral, perform simple screening and give clear advice to parents.
goal.ur: End tak aap flexible flat foot, in-toeing aur physiological bow legs ko un halaton se alag karenge jin ke liye referral chahiye, saada screening karenge aur walidain ko saaf mashwara denge.

text.en: Children's legs change as they grow. Most toddlers are **bow-legged**, most school-age children are **knock-kneed** for a time, and almost all babies have **flat feet** because the arch has not yet formed. **In-toeing** (feet turning in) is common and usually improves by itself by age eight to ten. These are **normal variants** when they are **painless, symmetrical, flexible** and the child is running and playing normally.
text.ur: Bachon ki taangein barhte hue badalti hain. Zyada tar chhote bachay **bow-legged** hote hain, school ki umar mein kuch der **knock-kneed**, aur lagbhag har bachay ke **flat feet** hote hain kyunke arch abhi nahi bana. **In-toeing** (pair andar ki taraf) aam hai aur aam taur par aath se das saal tak khud behtar ho jati hai. Yeh **normal variants** hain jab woh **bina dard, barabar (symmetrical), lachakdar** hon aur bachha normal daur kar khel raha ho.

text.en: Think of growing legs as **a building under construction**. The frame goes up in stages: the first version is bowed, the next is knocked-in and later the legs straighten. Judging the building during the work with the finished plan in mind is a mistake: you wait and watch unless something looks wrong.
text.ur: Barhti taangon ko **zer-e-taameer imarat** samjhein. Dhancha marhalon mein banta hai: pehle jhuka hua, phir andar ki taraf, aur baad mein seedha. Kaam ke dauran imarat ko mukammal naqshe se parkhna ghalti hai: aap intezaar karte hain aur dekhte hain jab tak kuch ghalat na lage.

title.en: Examining a child's feet and legs
title.ur: Bachay ke pair aur taangon ki examination

steps.title: Ask and watch
steps.detail: Ask when the parents noticed it, whether the child has pain, limps, trips or avoids play, and about birth history and family. Watch the child walk and run. || Poochhein aur dekhein

steps.title: Check the foot
steps.detail: With the child standing, look for an arch. Ask the child to rise onto the toes: if the arch appears, it is a flexible flat foot. A stiff flat foot that stays flat needs a specialist. || Pair dekhein

steps.title: Check the rotation
steps.detail: Measure where the turning comes from: the foot, the shin or the thigh. Use the hip rotation (prone), the thigh-foot angle and the foot's shape. Symmetry and range tell you what is normal for age. || Ghumao check karein

steps.title: Advise or refer
steps.detail: For painless, symmetrical, flexible findings, reassure and review in six to twelve months. Refer for pain, a limp, stiffness, one-sided findings, rapid change or short stature. || Mashwara ya referral

question.en: Which finding suggests a normal flexible flat foot?
question.ur: Kaun si finding normal flexible flat foot ki taraf ishara karti hai?

text.en: A foot that stays flat and stiff on tiptoe
text.ur: Pair jo ungliyon par bhi flat aur sakht rahe

feedback.en: That may be a rigid flat foot and needs referral.
feedback.ur: Yeh rigid flat foot ho sakta hai aur referral chahiye.

text.en: An arch that appears when the child rises onto the toes
text.ur: Arch jo ungliyon par uthne par nazar aaye

feedback.en: Yes — the arch is there but flattens under weight.
feedback.ur: Haan — arch maujood hai magar wazan mein dab jata hai.

rows.en: One side only, or very different
rows.ur: Sirf ek taraf, ya bohat mukhtalif
Sakht, langar ya khel se parhez

text.en: **Painless, equal, flexible: wait and watch.** If any of the three is missing, look closer. Reassurance backed by a clear examination is a treatment in itself.
text.ur: **Bina dard, barabar, lachakdar: intezaar aur nigrani.** In teeno mein se koi kam ho to qareeb se dekhein. Saaf examination par mabni tasalli khud ek ilaj hai.

text.en: **Selling insoles and exercises for a normal foot.** Evidence does not show that insoles or special shoes change the arch in flexible flat feet, and they cost money and worry. Explain the natural course instead, and treat only if there is pain or a functional problem.
text.ur: **Normal pair ke liye insoles aur exercises bechna.** Evidence nahi dikhata ke insoles ya khaas joote flexible flat feet mein arch badalte hain, aur yeh paisa aur fikr barhate hain. Qudrati silsila samjhayein, aur ilaj sirf tab karein jab dard ya functional masla ho.

question.en: A 4-year-old has bowed legs, no pain, both sides equal and is active. What should you do?
question.ur: 4 saal ke bachay ki taangein jhuki hui hain, dard nahi, dono taraf barabar aur woh active hai. Kya karein?

text.en: Reassure and review in a few months
text.ur: Tasalli dein aur kuch mahine baad review karein

feedback.en: Yes — physiological bow legs usually straighten by age three or four.
feedback.ur: Haan — physiological bow legs aam taur par teen chaar saal tak seedhi ho jati hain.

text.ur: Surgery ke liye foran refer karein

feedback.en: That is not needed for a normal variant.
feedback.ur: Normal variant ke liye zaroori nahi.

question.en: Which finding means referral for a child with in-toeing?
question.ur: In-toeing wale bachay mein kaun si finding referral ka matlab hai?

text.en: Both feet turn in equally and the child runs well
text.ur: Dono pair barabar andar murte hain aur bachha achha daurta hai

text.en: Pain, a limp or a stiff hip with one side clearly different
text.ur: Dard, langar ya akhra hua hip, ek taraf saaf mukhtalif

feedback.en: Yes — these can point to a hip or neurological problem.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh hip ya neurological masle ki taraf ishara kar sakte hain.

text.en: The child sometimes trips when tired
text.ur: Bachha thakne par kabhi kabhi thokar khata hai

feedback.en: That is common in young children.

text.en: **Give parents a simple message.** "This is part of normal growth. Your child's feet are flexible and painless, which is what we want to see. We do not need shoes or exercises. Please come back if there is pain, a limp or if one side looks different, and we will check again in six months." Written advice helps families remember.
text.ur: **Walidain ko saada paigham dein.** "Yeh normal nashonuma ka hissa hai. Aap ke bachay ke pair lachakdar aur bina dard hain, jo hum dekhna chahte hain. Joote ya exercises ki zaroorat nahi. Dard, langar ya ek taraf mukhtalif lage to wapas aayein, aur hum chhe mahine mein dobara dekhenge." Likhi hui hidayat khandan ko yaad rakhne mein madad deti hai.

question.en: Why is a one-sided finding more worrying than a two-sided one?
question.ur: Ek taraf ki finding do taraf ki se zyada fikr ki baat kyun hai?

answer.en: Normal growth variants affect both legs alike because they come from the same stage of development. A difference between the sides suggests a local problem such as a hip, bone growth or neurological condition.
answer.ur: Normal nashonuma ke variants dono taangon ko ek jaisa mutasir karte hain kyunke yeh nashonuma ke ek hi marhale se aate hain. Dono sides mein farq kisi mukami masle, maslan hip, haddi ki nashonuma ya neurological halat, ki taraf ishara karta hai.

beats.patient: A 3-year-old boy is brought because his feet turn in. He walks and runs well, has no pain, and his hip rotation is similar on both sides with a normal thigh-foot angle. His mother is worried and wants special shoes.
beats.assessment: The picture is a normal variant of in-toeing that usually improves by itself; special shoes are not needed.
beats.treatment: Explain the natural course, reassure, give written advice and offer review in six to twelve months.
beats.reassess: At review the in-toeing is less noticeable and the mother is relieved.

text.en: **Refer promptly** for pain, a limp, stiffness, a swollen joint, one-sided findings, fast change, short stature, delayed walking, weakness, a rigid flat foot, or in-toeing with a hip that does not turn out. A child with fever and refusal to bear weight needs urgent medical care.
text.ur: **Jald refer karein** dard, langar, akhrapan, soojhe joint, ek taraf ki findings, tez tabdeeli, chhota qad, der se chalna, kamzori, rigid flat foot, ya in-toeing jis mein hip bahar nahi mudta. Bukhar aur wazan na utha pane wale bachay ko foran medical care chahiye.

summary.en: Flat feet, in-toeing and bow legs are usually normal variants when painless, symmetrical and flexible.
summary.ur: Flat feet, in-toeing aur bow legs aam taur par normal variants hain jab bina dard, barabar aur lachakdar hon.

summary.en: Examine the arch on tiptoe, the rotation (hip, thigh-foot angle) and walking, and reassure with a clear explanation.
summary.ur: Ungliyon par arch, ghumao (hip, thigh-foot angle) aur chalna examine karein, aur saaf wazahat ke saath tasalli dein.

summary.en: Refer for pain, limp, stiffness, one-sided findings, rapid change or a rigid foot; do not prescribe insoles for normal feet.
summary.ur: Dard, langar, akhrapan, ek taraf ki findings, tez tabdeeli ya rigid pair par refer karein; normal pair ke liye insoles na dein.

front.en: What makes a flat foot flexible?
front.ur: Flat foot lachakdar kab hota hai?

back.en: The arch appears when the child rises onto the toes.
back.ur: Ungliyon par uthne par arch nazar aata hai.

back.en: By itself, usually by age eight to ten.
back.ur: Khud, aam taur par aath se das saal tak.

front.en: Name two signs that need referral.

back.en: Pain, a limp, stiffness, or one-sided findings.
back.ur: Dard, langar, akhrapan, ya ek taraf ki findings.

front.en: Do insoles change a flexible flat foot?
front.ur: Kya insoles flexible flat foot badalte hain?

back.en: Evidence does not show that they do.
back.ur: Evidence nahi dikhata ke badalte hain.

note.en: The conditions that look like normal variants but are not.
note.ur: Woh halatein jo normal variants jaisi lagti hain magar nahi.
